Relocation sequences cool-down, gas disconnect certified, instrument cases, and recalibration appointment destination before first cupping.

This guide relocates coffee labs transporting sample roasters and moisture meters safely.

Sample roaster protocol

  • Full cool-down before wrap—fire risk.
  • Gas disconnect licensed if applicable.
  • Drum lock transport position manual.
  • Control panel blanket face.
  • Upright orientation; vibration pad truck nest.

Moisture meters and lab gear

Hard case each; calibration standard beans bag hand-carry; cupping bowls cell box; grinder burr lock; green sample sealed labeled not contaminate.

Green coffee inventory

Breathable bags; moisture log; fumigation certificate if export context; separate from chemical cleaning supplies.

Extra planning notes

Share origin and destination addresses, stair count, and elevator rules when you request a quote. Keep passports, leases, and small electronics off the truck until the final walk-through. If management requires deposits for lifts or gates, pay only after you have a confirmed move window in writing.

Weather and holidays can shift traffic—buffer half a day on long cross-town legs. For inter-city or storage legs, confirm whether overnight hold or next-day unload is included in your quote line items.
